description: This morning, I was honored to join Mayor Christenson, State Representative Paul Donato and State Representative Kate Lipper-Garabedian for the promotion and induction ceremony of Malden Fire’s Chief Bill Sullivan, alongside other officers and new firefighters in the Department. Congratulations to all for this recognition of your leadership and service to our community!

title: Malden Firefighters Promoted
